lines.text: Pharisees tested Jesus about divorce, and He said the Creator made them male and female, so man must not separate.
The disciples rebuked those bringing children, but Jesus said the kingdom of heaven belongs to those who teach them.

problems.problem: It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
Its true detail "such as these children" isn't in Matthew 19:14 word for word.
